info.name: ScaleSerum - Vision Lab
info.description:
LAST UPDATED 2026-09-10 - adds 00 Upload a video (POST /api/vision-lab/upload).
IMPORTING OVER AN OLDER COPY: choose REPLACE, not 'Import as copy' - a copy is
what produces the [CONFLICT] duplicate in the sidebar. Replacing clears the
variables; re-enter api_key (creative_url is filled in by 00).





AI-predicted attention analysis for ad creatives.

RUN THE FOLDERS IN ORDER. `1 Happy path` submits a creative, polls it to completion and then exercises history, rescore and delete. `2 Failure paths` covers every reason code the UI branches on, and is the half that catches regressions - the happy path rarely breaks quietly.

BEFORE YOU RUN
1. Set `base_url` (http://localhost:3001 locally).
2. Set `api_key` to the API_KEY from .env. It ships BLANK - never commit a real one.
3. EITHER run `00 Upload a video` (pick a file in its Body tab - it fills
   `creative_url` for you), OR set `creative_url` to a presigned GET link:
     python scripts/presign.py vision-lab-test/Ads1.mp4
   The four uploaded ads are Ads1.mp4, Ad2.mp4, Ad3.mp4 and Ad4.mp4 under
   s3://aife-media-prod/vision-lab-test/.
4. The service needs VL_ENABLED=true and the URL's host in VL_ALLOWED_URL_HOSTS.
5. vision-worker must be running, or every poll stays at `queued`:
     python -m vision_lab.worker
   RESTART THE WORKER, not just the API, after any change to vision_lab/ - the
   pipeline runs in the worker process.

6. Collection Runner -> set Delay to 3000 ms. That is what paces the polling loop.

MILESTONE D: the report is complete. `stub` is false, all six scores are real, and
the transcript, the 15 triggers and the written recommendations are each either
present or state why they are absent.

Request 03 prints two things to the console that no assertion can judge for you:
  EVIDENCE AUDIT - what the model tried to say and could not support.
  MODEL INVENTED DEFECTS - anything it nominated that Python had not found.
Both should normally be small. Watch them; they are how you notice the
interpretation layer drifting.

Transcription and interpretation are OPTIONAL. Without DEEPGRAM_API_KEY or
GEMINI_API_KEY the analysis still completes with every measurement and every
score - the affected blocks say why they are missing. Folder 0 reports which of
them this server has.

On success the returned link is written into `creative_url` automatically, so 01 runs next exactly as before.

Set `analyze` to true to also queue the analysis in this one call - then skip 01 and go straight to 02.

item.description: A .mp4 key declared as application/pdf. The refusal happens in the worker, so poll the returned id to see it. This is a real mismatch worth surfacing: an S3 object whose ContentType contradicts its key must not be guessed around and handed to ffmpeg.

item.name: 3 The rest of the service still works
item.description: Vision Lab must not be able to break the three features that were already live. Run this after every Vision Lab change.

exec: // READ EVERY SCOPE, NOT JUST THE COLLECTION.
// Postman resolves {{api_key}} from the environment first, then the
// collection, then globals. This guard used to read only the collection
// copy, so an api_key set in an environment - which Postman's own
// assistant tells you to do - made the request valid and the guard block
// it anyway. pm.variables.get() resolves exactly as the request will.
// A PASTED URL OFTEN ARRIVES WITH A LINE BREAK IN IT.
// A long presigned URL wraps when copied out of a terminal or a chat, and
// the break comes along with it. A raw newline inside a JSON string is
// illegal, so the request dies at the FastAPI layer with
// `422 json_invalid / Invalid control character` - which looks like a
// server fault and is not one. No presigned URL contains whitespace, so
// stripping all of it is safe.
console.log('creative_url contained whitespace (probably a line break from ' +
'copying). Stripped it - the value is now one line.');
// STOP ON AN UNSET VARIABLE INSTEAD OF SENDING AN EMPTY ONE.
// An empty creative_url is a valid request as far as the API is concerned:
// it comes back `no_creative`, which reads like a service bug. An empty
'api_key is empty, so every request will come back 401. Set it in ' +
'Collection > Variables > api_key > CURRENT VALUE (or in your active ' +
'creative_url is empty. Sending this would submit an empty URL and come ' +
'back as `no_creative` - the service is fine, the variable is not. Run ' +
'00 Upload a video to fill it in, or paste a presigned URL into ' +
'Collection > Variables > creative_url > CURRENT VALUE, then press Ctrl+S.');
// A presigned URL expires. Say so before the worker fails on a 403.
throw new Error('The presigned creative_url expired ' + (-left) + ' minutes ago. ' +
'Run 00 Upload a video again, or generate a new one: ' +
if (left < 10) { console.log('WARNING: creative_url expires in ' + left + ' minutes.'); }
